question: Where can I find hotel inside 20 kilometers as I travel from Top of the Rock, New York, NY toward Speert Green, Wayne, NJ?
sql: SELECT poi_name, addr_city, addr_state FROM pois WHERE tourism = 'hotel' AND ST_Intersects(geometry, ST_Buffer(ST_MakeLine( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Top of the Rock%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%New York%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NY%' LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Speert Green%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Wayne%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NJ%' LIMIT 1 ) )::geography, 20000)::geometry) ORDER BY ST_Distance(geometry, ST_MakeLine( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Top of the Rock%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%New York%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NY%' LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Speert Green%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Wayne%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%NJ%' LIMIT 1 ) )::geography);
